purpose: Test whether a close-confirmed SPY breakout after the first 30 minutes of a scheduled pre-open BLS event session continues to a fixed noon exit, without using relative ranking, direction inversion, shorting, leverage, or protected data.

supported_observations: Event Repricing 001 closed the exact signed QQQ-minus-SPY leader-continuation contract; its numeric results do not select this plan's parameters.
Event Drift 001 closed a joint-positive opening-gap and reaction contract; it did not test a later close-confirmed SPY opening-range breakout.
Earlier every-session opening-range research did not isolate causally established scheduled pre-open BLS event sessions with one entry and a fixed noon exit.
The existing calibrated SPY execution model supports prospective buffers that are several times its severe displayed-spread round-trip cost.
research_basis.new_hypothesis: A scheduled pre-open macro release can concentrate price discovery into the opening auction. A SPY close above the completed first-30-minute range during the next 30 minutes may mark continued broad-market repricing through noon.
prohibited_inferences: Do not invert, retune, rescue, or rerun an Intraday Event Repricing 001 candidate or gate.
Do not use Event Repricing return, reaction, concentration, or activation values to choose any numeric input in this plan.
Do not reuse Event Drift's joint opening-gap or joint reaction rule.
Do not treat the reused event schedule or pre-May bars as untouched controlled evidence.
Do not inspect opening-breakout returns before this plan and its independent review are frozen.
Do not add shorting, leverage, June, V3, daily 2018-2019, PAPER, broker, or live access.

inheritance.interpretation: Only the listed sections inherit exact base-plan bytes and meaning. Event Drift strategy mechanics, candidates, reactions, opening-gap rule, exit, screens, runtime, and reports are not inherited. This plan supplies a new SPY-only signal, candidates, gates, budget, evidence, and namespace. QQQ remains zero-weight and signal-ineligible; it stays in the inherited complete-universe dataset and report benchmarks only.

strategy_contract.economic_hypothesis: After a scheduled pre-open BLS release, a close-confirmed SPY breakout above the completed opening auction range may continue through noon because broad-market information is still being absorbed.
strategy_contract.bar_indexing: Zero-based within each validated XNYS regular session.
strategy_contract.opening_range: After bars 0 through 5 fully complete at 10:00 ET, set opening_range_high to the maximum SPY high across those six bars. The range never changes later in the session.
strategy_contract.monitoring_rule: Inspect SPY closes only after completed bars 6 through 11, from 10:05 through 10:30 ET. Activate at the first close greater than or equal to the frozen breakout threshold. A high-only breach, an earlier opening-range value, or a later close does not activate.
strategy_contract.entry_rule: After the first qualifying completed close, target SPY at weight 0.5 and QQQ at zero. The inherited scenario delay fills at bar index breakout_bar_index+d, where d is 1, 2, or 3.
strategy_contract.exit_rule: Target SPY flat after completed bar index 29. Scenario delay d fills at bar index 29+d, at 12:00, 12:05, or 12:10 ET. QQQ remains flat for the full run.
strategy_contract.early_close_rule: The latest delay-3 exit fills at index 32, before the known 13:00 ET early-close final bar-open index 41. Mandatory engine flatten remains a fail-closed backstop, not a planned exit.
strategy_contract.one_entry_invariant: An active event must complete exactly one SPY same-session round trip and zero QQQ fills or round trips. Any resize, reentry, QQQ trade, entry outside the frozen monitoring window, or exit outside the frozen decision contract is terminal.
strategy_contract.parameter_rationale: Six opening bars and six monitoring bars use fixed 30-minute clock blocks, not prior campaign outputs. Buffers 2, 4, and 8 basis points form a prospective doubling sequence; the 2-basis-point floor exceeds four times the calibrated severe SPY two-fill displayed-spread cost of 0.44 basis points. Bar 29 fixes a noon decision boundary and avoids a holding-period search axis.

parameters.neighbor_rule: Immediate neighbors use the adjacent buffer value. Neighbor IDs are sorted ascending and the graph is symmetric.

serious_candidate_screen.cross_scenario_signal_trace_rule: Every scenario for one candidate-period must have the same signal_trace_fingerprint. Any mismatch is terminal before screening.
serious_candidate_screen.positive_neighbor: An immediate neighbor whose four-period aggregate Normal and zero-cost net profit and total return are all strictly positive.
serious_candidate_screen.neighbor_topology: The exact 1.0 joint-positive-neighbor gate requires every immediate neighbor to pass. Corners require 1/1 and the center requires 2/2; no rounding is permitted.

stage_rules.final_cohort_rule: Freeze the serious candidate only if it passes every frozen stress and neighbor gate. Do not result-rank, substitute a neighbor, or change a parameter.
stage_rules.empty_cohort_action: Close as immutable negative exposed evidence and start only a separately frozen hypothesis.
stage_rules.nonempty_cohort_action: Freeze the survivor and wait for future untouched data. Do not create a controlled plan for June or substitute another exposed range.

search_budget.unit: One immutable run specification contains one candidate, period, and cost or delay scenario.

immediate_neighbor_maximum.formula: at most 1 additional neighbor * 4 periods * 2 scenarios after exact evidence reuse

search_budget.budget_invariant: The runner must identify runs only by candidate-period-scenario, deduplicate those identities, reuse exact matching evidence, and reject any reservation that would exceed 46 specifications. The three-attempt ceiling permits at most 138 attempts and remains infrastructure recovery, not added search.

report_contract.active_event: One eligible event with exactly one completed SPY same-session round trip, zero QQQ fills and round trips, a first close-confirmed breakout at a completed bar index from 6 through 11, and an exit decision after completed bar index 29.
report_contract.signal_trace_fingerprint: Fingerprint event ID, candidate buffer, opening_range_high, breakout_threshold, active flag, first breakout bar index, breakout decision timestamp, and exit decision timestamp. It excludes cost, delay, fill price, slippage, fee, and scenario.
report_contract.signal_trace_identity: Normal, zero-cost, stress, and isolated-delay reports for the same candidate-period must have equal signal_trace_fingerprint values. A mismatch, QQQ trade, missing or duplicate event, or signal outside the frozen bars is terminal before screening.
report_contract.event_ledger_row: Record event_id, release_name, scheduled_utc, xnys_session, active, opening_range_high, breakout_buffer_bps, breakout_threshold, breakout_bar_index, breakout_decision_timestamp, entry_fill_timestamp, exit_decision_timestamp, exit_fill_timestamp, gross_profit_loss, adverse_slippage, regulatory_fees, and net_profit_loss. Inactive events retain opening range and threshold but use null breakout, entry, and exit fields and zero P&L.

metric_definitions.event_activation_fraction: active_event_count / eligible_event_count; undefined when the denominator is zero.
metric_definitions.event_net_profit_loss: For an active event, SPY gross profit minus every event fill's adverse slippage and the exact allocated account-day regulatory fees; zero for an inactive event.
metric_definitions.release_class_net_profit_loss: Sum event net P&L by the three fixed release names, including inactive-event zeros.
metric_definitions.positive_concentration: For event or release-class net P&L values, maximum strictly positive value divided by the sum of strictly positive values; undefined when no value is positive.
metric_definitions.positive_fold: A fold whose net_profit_loss and total_return in that scenario are both strictly positive.
metric_definitions.positive_normal_fold_count: Count the four Normal folds satisfying positive_fold.
metric_definitions.minimum_active_events_in_positive_normal: Minimum Normal active_event_count among positive Normal folds; undefined when none is positive.
metric_definitions.stress_profit_retention: Scenario aggregate net P&L divided by base Normal aggregate net P&L over the same periods; undefined unless the Normal denominator is strictly positive.
metric_definitions.positive_neighbor: A neighbor whose four-period aggregate Normal and zero-cost net_profit_loss and total_return are all strictly positive.
metric_definitions.joint_positive_neighbor_fraction: Count positive neighbors divided by the exact immediate-neighbor count without rounding.
metric_definitions.neighbor_normal_profit_retention: Neighbor four-period aggregate Normal net P&L divided by the positive base candidate Normal net P&L.
metric_definitions.median_neighbor_normal_profit_retention: Use statistics.median over every immediate-neighbor retention. A missing or undefined value makes the gate undefined and failing.
metric_definitions.fold_aggregation: Concatenate event ledgers in frozen period order. Period and event IDs must be disjoint. Sum returns under the inherited convention, gross P&L, friction, and net P&L, then recompute concentrations from the concatenated event values rather than averaging fold concentrations.
metric_definitions.accounting_identity: gross_profit_loss - execution_friction = net_profit_loss within the frozen accounting precision.
metric_definitions.undefined_action: Every undefined metric named by a gate fails that gate.

report_contract.benchmark_references: Retain inherited cash, SPY-continuous, QQQ-continuous, and fixed-50/50 report-only benchmarks over evaluation bars. They are not gates and grant no authority.
report_contract.authority: Every report and aggregate is exposed research evidence only. No result can grant qualification, controlled evaluation, holdout, PAPER, broker-write, live, or promotion authority.

runtime.implementation_gate: Merge this plan and its finding-free independent review. Then implement the strict inherited-plan loader, SPY-only strategy and event report, 46-run budget, spawned runner, CLI, and tests on a separate branch. Bind exact merged implementation main and a finding-free launch-control review before the first reservation.

controlled_evaluation.empty_cohort_action: Close as immutable negative exposed evidence and start only a separately frozen hypothesis.
controlled_evaluation.nonempty_cohort_action: Freeze every all-gate exposed-serious survivor simultaneously and wait for future untouched data. Do not rank, tune, discard, or claim controlled qualification.
